sous_titre: Nombre de nouvelles molécules autorisées par an, et moyennes de référence

2024.texte: In 2024, CDER approved 50 new drugs never before approved or marketed in the U.S.

2025.texte: In 2025, CDER approved 46 new drugs never before approved or marketed in the U.S.

Moyenne 2016-2025.texte: from 2016 through 2025, CDER has averaged approximately 47 novel drug approvals per year

Moyenne depuis 2007.texte: above the historical average of 38 novel drugs per year since 2007
